description:
- Location monitoring updates only added, changed or removed geofences, preserving registrations during unrelated task edits.
- Failed location and Wi-Fi alarm handoffs no longer consume the arrival; future queued reminders recover when reopening Ping or restoring exact-alarm access.
- Duplicate or cancelled alarm callbacks no longer show another notification.
- Location requests expire at the provider after 30 seconds, and inactive tasks stop being tracked promptly.
